pages.text: An upgraded form of the $(l:goetymech_focuses/gateway_focus)Gateway Focus$(/l), capable of teleporting across dimensions to the vicinity of a target destination.$(br)When casting with a Structure Eye or a map containing coordinates (such as a treasure map, woodland mansion map, etc.) in the off-hand, the caster will be teleported to the vicinity of the corresponding structure.$(br)Upon arrival, the caster enters a one-minute Clairvoyant state, allowing them to scout the surrounding area in a manner similar to Spectator Mode, making it easier to locate their target.$(br)$(4)"With this, we can go wherever we please."$()
